articles.title: US restarts three shut-down nuclear reactors to feed AI data centers
articles.text:
The current and expected power draw of AI data centers has been the subject of strong discussion, but today, there appears to be some good news. Three U.S. nuclear reactors are being restarted after many years offline, expected to bring 2.25 GW total to the grid. According to a report, the Palisades Nuclear Plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center on Three Mile Island (Pennsylvania), and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa are getting a fresh set of proverbial tires to get rolling again.
Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers
(Image credit: Microsoft)
The data center cooling state of play
The custom AI ASIC state of play
America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the price
GTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this year
Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible
The Palisades plant was under active decommissioning, apparently marking this event as the first time a nuclear reactor is being put back to work after dismantling had begun. Despite what sounds like a tough starting point, this plant is the one that's furthest along, as it was loading fuel in August 2026 and is expected to generate 800 MW around March 2027.
Much like the other projects mentioned here, the Holtec Palisades firm running the reactor took a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy. Palisades borrowed from the DoE under the Biden administration's 2024 investment in nuclear energy, while the others were issued under the purview of the Trump administration's 2025 push.
The second reactor is the Crane Clean Energy Center on Pennsylvania's Three Mile Island, repurposing the facility's Unit 1. The project started in 2024, with Constellation Energy saying it would spend $1.6 billion total for the reactor. The firm then took a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft is set to be the main customer, with a 20-year contract. This facility is projected to bring 835 MW online sometime in 2027.
This facility was famous in 1979 for the partial meltdown of its Unit 2, although mercifully the event had relatively tame environmental consequences. Constellation's ongoing project is restoring and refurbishing Unit 1, which didn't show significant issues until its 2019 decommissioning and has undergone a safety inspection from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. This entity still needs to grant its blessing before the reactor starts loading fuel.
The Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa is the third unit being brought back to the grid, in a collaboration between NextEra Energy and Google. The predicted output is 615 MW, with the juice expected to start flowing in 2029. Next Energy CEO John Ketchum stated that the firm was happy with its cooperation contract with Google, as it meant that "none of the costs are being paid by residential customers in Iowa."
All three facilities had previously been shut down at various points as they were deemed too expensive to run, as labor and maintenance costs made nuclear-generated watts pricier than alternative means of production.
But the financial landscape for power has shifted, plus with such overwhelming demand and grid connections being a primary blocker for data center buildouts, their operators are likely willing to pay for premium power as long as they get it now instead of in a few decades.
Some quick browsing indicates that Michigan is going to need somewhere between 1.2 and 2.3 GW for data centers alone around 2030. Pennsylvania's forecast has a wide range of 0.8 to 3.4 GW, while Iowa's range is 1.55 to 2.8 GW. These figures are loose, as they include planned capacity for data center projects that may or may not end up being built, and whose timetables may slip due to economic conditions, hardware availability, and public resistance against expansive buildouts.

articles.title: 喊出300万张订单，英伟达RTX PRO 5500为何遭到提前疯抢？
articles.text:
在AI算力市场，等风声传开再下注，往往已经慢了半拍。早在8月份，服务器产品经理夏寅卿已经开始向客户推介还未面世的RTX PRO 5500。一个月后，这张最新PRO系列专业工作站显卡才默默出现在英伟达官网。然而，RTX PRO 5500在中国市场引发的动静，远不如它正式亮相时那般低调——有大厂被传计划采购100万张；跨界布局算力租赁的天阳科技，签订2万张采购合同的消息经公众号平台发布当天，股价上涨12.38%。夏寅卿用“疯狂”来形容国内采购热潮，称订购规模已达数百万张，接近英伟达预计的全球产能。与此同时，这张尚未批量交付，实际性能也有待验证的新卡，还被卷入了另一张热门显卡的停产风波。有海外社媒爆料称，英伟达计划将GB202芯片的后续供应转向包含RTX PRO 5500在内的RTX PRO系列，不再向旗舰游戏显卡RTX 5090分配芯片产能。消息尚未得到英伟达正式确认，但价格本就水涨船高的5090，国内部分渠道报价已进一步攀升至5.7万元左右。一边是新卡尚未交付，买家已经争相下注；另一边，现有的专业卡、消费级显卡的供需和价格也被推到了新的风口。英伟达非数据中心卡在中国的生意将迎来哪些转变？
01
合规之外，5500
还有哪些值得被争抢的筹码？合规，是部分中国企业采购英伟达GPU时首先要锚定的必要条件。“英伟达将RTX PRO 5500定位为专业工作站GPU，是为了更容易通过相关审批。”智算中心服务商老林直言。相较上一代RTX PRO 6000分化出服务器版、工作站版等版本，从英伟达目前公开的信息看，这一次的RTX PRO 5500只押注一条线。在RTX PRO 5500之前，为了应对美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）等相关部门对先进计算芯片的管制，英伟达陆续推出面向中国市场的特供型号，围绕计算能力、显存带宽等指标做出取舍。RTX PRO 6000D就是其中一个典例。基于几位受访者提供的参数，在常用的AI计算精度下，这款特供产品的算力仅占RTX PRO 6000服务器版的三至四成。有RTX PRO 6000D的性能大幅缩水在前，目前暂未声明有特供型号的RTX PRO 5500算力表现是否也会大打折扣，自然备受关注。结合官方理论参数和夏寅卿给到的数据，在FP4、FP8等精度下，RTX PRO 5500的理论算力较RTX PRO 6000D提升约一倍。除此之外，接近英伟达的算力服务从业者秦宇还关注到RTX PRO 5500支持MIG（Multi-Instance GPU，多实例GPU）功能，这也是他眼中RTX PRO 5500相较于RTX PRO 6000D的一项重要优势。根据官方介绍，拥有RTX PRO 6000D同等显存容量的RTX PRO 5500，可以通过MIG划分出两个各含42GB显存的计算板块，不同的AI推理任务可以在同一张GPU上独立运行，提高了算力资源利用率。而RTX PRO 5500 84GB的显存容量，本身也有着不小的吸引力。夏寅卿观察到，大显存专业GPU的行情今年明显升温。以RTX PRO 6000服务器版为例，其渠道价格在去年年底经历一轮下跌后，已从今年年初的6万元至7万元涨至18万元至19万元。市场对大显存的渴求甚至催生了民间改装生意——9月深圳曾传出32GB显存的RTX 5090被“魔改”为96GB版本的消息。在夏寅卿看来，这与此前尚未充分释放的终端需求开始爆发有关。随着具身智能、智能驾驶等应用的发展，以及大模型部署需求的增加，部分场景已经走向商业闭环。但终端需求再旺盛、业务再怎么闭环，采购成本仍是绕不开的一笔账。目前，市面上RTX PRO 5500预期交付报价集中在8万元至12万元区间。其中，专注于4090、5090算力服务的Jack透露，其了解到的大厂采购报价约为8.5万元，部分渠道报价升至8.7万元。满足正规采购要求、大显存、尚有竞争力的理论算力，再加上大客户预报价接近RTX PRO 6000服务器版当前渠道价的一半，买家提前锁定货源的行为就不难理解。秦宇了解到，当前国内RTX PRO 5500的订购规模已超过300万张，而英伟达每季度向中国市场供应的上限实际上只有50万张。有关具体交付时间，根据外媒援引知情人士的报道，英伟达计划从今年12月底开始向中国市场交付RTX PRO 5500。而Jack从渠道获得的消息则更为乐观，称最快11月月底便可能开始交付。而夏寅卿则了解到，与英伟达建立OEM合作关系的所有头部服务器厂商将在11月拿到样品卡，随后还需要完成测试和服务器适配。按照他的判断，正式批量交付最快也要等到明年第一季度。而在这小半年的空窗期里，留给英伟达现有GPU市场的，究竟是千载难逢的机会，还是提前到来的危机？（更多市场观察，欢迎添加作者 Evelynn7778 一起探讨。）
02
6000D回落至7万元5090涨破5万元，5500会改变谁的行情？相较于一年前，RTX PRO 6000D如今的市场境遇有所改善。彼时，大型买家仍在观望H20、B30A等产品的供应进展，由于本身性价比不足，这款顶着“合规”名头的小卡并未获得青睐。进入2026年，曾经不被看好的特供卡渠道报价已从年中约5万元涨至8月的7万元以上，之后虽有所回落，但仍维持在7万元左右。有海外GPU供应经验的小岚认为，经过专业团队调优，RTX PRO 6000D在部分场景中的实际表现可以接近RTX PRO 6000。做服务器生意的David则提醒，评判性能表现，得从具体业务出发。如果场景主要依赖显存容量和带宽，两款产品的实际差距可能并不明显；但显卡应用于计算密集型任务，靠调优来弥补早被削减的差距，终究有上限。当理论算力更高、同样拥有84GB显存的RTX PRO 5500即将入场，属于同系列的RTX PRO 6000D是否会停产？现有的价格还能维持多久？更多信息可联系作者 Evelynn7778 讨论。RTX PRO 5500的到来，还牵动着5090的命运。有媒体统计主流电商平台上的售价，当前5090价格已突破5万元，一个月内涨幅超50%。涨价背后的原因难以一概而论，但5090的货源紧张，早在近期的停产传闻出现前就已有迹可循。夏寅卿透露，数月前，部分与英伟达有合作的显卡厂商，能够供应的5090就已十分有限。而中间贸易商的囤货惜售，进一步加剧了市场的紧张情绪。偏偏此时，GB202产能可能重新分配的爆料又在国内外互联网中疯传，5090若真面临减产甚至停产，眼下的高价恐怕还不是终点。不过，对于是否停产的判断，雷峰网所交流的数位受访者有所分歧：一方认为，AI业务带来的收益远超游戏，英伟达有理由将更多芯片资源向专业GPU倾斜；另一方则指出，在下一代消费级旗舰显卡问世前，5090仍承担着维持英伟达高端消费级产品定位的角色，大幅减产比彻底停产更有可能。此外，新一轮的涨价并非没有天花板。Jack指出，一路上涨的单卡价格，并未同步传导至服务器租赁市场。他所了解到的月租报价仅从约1.3万元涨至不足1.5万元。而RTX PRO 5500的入场也可能同时从需求端戳破5090的价格泡沫。按照目前的预报价，一张RTX PRO 5500的价格已接近两张5090，显存容量却超过后者之和。对于有大显存需求或者需要合规采购的客户而言，RTX PRO 5500的吸引力不容小觑。一旦部分买家选择采购或租赁RTX PRO 5500，5090的紧俏行情或将松动，价格也可能随之回落。RTX PRO 5500可能动摇的，还有一批服务器厂商靠5090建立起来的竞争优势。David介绍，此前部分与英伟达建立OEM合作关系的服务器厂商在相关要求下很难推出搭载5090的服务器。一些不受限的厂商则抓住了这个空当，通过使用改装后的5090显卡，或专门设计能够容纳原装5090的服务器，在这一市场做出了差异化。但随着RTX PRO 5500这类可直接用于企业级机架部署的专业GPU上市，所有厂商都有机会通过标准服务器承接相关推理需求。David坦言，这意味着5090服务器厂商曾经依靠错位竞争建立的竞争优势可能会被削弱，接下来不得不在更大的服务器市场里比拼价格、客户关系和服务等。至于这场竞争究竟会有多激烈，还得看RTX PRO 5500交付后的实际表现。关于接下来AI服务器生意的冷暖与变数，欢迎与作者 Evelynn7778 交流。* 文中受访者均为匿名雷峰网雷峰网

articles.title: European Leaders Turn to NVIDIA Vera CPUs to Build Local Infrastructure
articles.text:
Nebius and Nscale are among global technology partners looking to NVIDIA Vera CPUs to build the next wave of infrastructure.
Their momentum reflects rapid advancements in agentic computing.
Agents do more than generate answers: they retrieve information, run software tools, execute code and evaluate results. Each step depends on fast CPU processing.
Vera accelerates that work, helping agents respond faster and enabling data centers to make better use of computing capacity. Vera is designed to sustain that speed even when running thousands of tasks simultaneously, helping organizations expand services without trading responsiveness for scale.
Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements
Building Europe’s Computing Capacity
AI cloud providers Nebius, Nscale and Verda are building with Vera to support the growing computing needs of businesses and developers. High-performance, energy-efficient CPUs help these providers scale the data processing and software execution behind services, alongside the GPUs running models.
The broader sovereign AI ecosystem also includes Aleria, a sovereign AI infrastructure and platform provider, supporting demand for infrastructure that keeps data and operations under customers’ control.
More Ways to Put Vera to Work
Server manufacturers Bull, Dell Technologies, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are building Vera-based systems, giving customers more deployment options for their high-performance computing and AI data centers. Vera can power standalone CPU servers or work alongside NVIDIA GPUs in accelerated systems, supporting different workloads and deployment needs.
Data processing companies ClickHouse, Cloudera, Duck Labs, Elastic, Polars, Redpanda, SAP and Starburst observed strong results on Vera for analytical, extract-transform-and-load and semantic search workloads in early testing. Vera’s per-core performance, LPDDR5X memory bandwidth and NVIDIA Scalable Coherency Fabric help achieve performance gains across the board.
Software and developer-platform companies Atlassian, Inherent and Nous Research are adopting Vera for environments where AI agents work alongside developers and researchers. Atlassian is looking to Vera to accelerate the data processing that builds semantic search indexes for its AI-powered products; Inherent has tested Vera and is looking to adopt it for environments where AI agents work alongside engineers on novel scientific research; and Nous Research uses Vera to authenticate agent identities and validate every action before it executes, keeping deployments secure as agent fleets grow.
Baseten-Blaxel, Daytona, E2B, Modal, Prime Intellect and Vercel provide cloud-based sandboxes, which serve as computers for AI agents, and are building on Vera to power the infrastructure agents depend on to execute code, run tools and test results.
Every agent needs a secure, isolated sandbox that can be provisioned instantly, and because sandboxes spin up millions of times a day, the speed of each individual startup cycle compounds at scale. Vera’s fast per-core performance and high-bandwidth memory make it well suited to this pattern, giving sandbox providers the throughput not only to spin up sandboxes but to run agentic workloads at maximum scale without interruption.
Learn more about the NVIDIA Vera CPU.

articles.title: When Opposite Premises Translate Identically: A Source-Conditioned Diagnostic for Multilingual Commonsense Items
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24428v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multilingual reasoning comparisons depend on translated premises preserving the relations in their English sources. Automatic translation scores can rank source-target pairs, but an acceptance decision alone cannot certify a counterfactual benchmark field. We test a source-contrast diagnostic for ACCORD premises: reverse the English polarity, translate both arms independently, count identical target outputs, and score each arm against its own source. Across 71 matched question identities at two containing-item depths, five target languages, and three translation checkpoints, Swahili has 63, 113, and 67 exact collisions among 710 pairs per checkpoint. At a human-reference-calibrated threshold, round-trip NLI passes both arms of 3 of the 113 NLLB-3.3B collisions, while LaBSE passes 78. Each collision proves at least one unfaithful translation, but does not identify its arm. These controlled measurements do not establish screening accuracy on spontaneous translation errors or a language-by-hop reasoning effect; the study has no native equivalence labels or answer-model evaluation.

articles.title: U.S. Army developing program that would deploy AI agents to autonomously seek and destroy targets in enemy digital infrastructures
articles.text:
The U.S. Army is allegedly developing a program to deploy autonomous AI agents that can navigate digital and network infrastructures, identify targets, and “neutralize” them. According to an Oct. 19 report by The Intercept, citing leaked official documents from the Army Cyber Command (ARCYBER), the nascent program, codenamed “ECHOTRIBBLE,” is primarily focused on offensive missions with the goal of neutralizing targets by “disabling the threat completely or temporarily, deleting the threat from the target.”
The program purportedly seeks to develop modular, autonomous AI agents that would function like computer worms, stealthily navigating adversary networks, moving between devices, and self-replicating across different operating systems. The agents would operate lightly in contested cloud environments and air-gapped systems alike, keeping reports minimal and concealing any required transmissions. Once an agent identifies and neutralizes a target, it would self-destruct, ideally without alerting the target or leaving any traces of its existence.
Cybersecurity experts have raised safety concerns about the project. A recent string of events has seen AI agents escape their environments and autonomously execute unassigned tasks. The document says the army will implement “predefined triggers” to help agents precisely distinguish targets. However, experts worry that if agents designed for benign tasks could execute unplanned, sometimes dangerous, actions to achieve those tasks, what should be expected of self-replicating agents designed specifically for offensive missions? Anthropic’s experiments showed AI agents can set up inference on different hardware and replicate across a network.
The Army also wants the agents to be capable of “Self-Directed Behavior,” acting with as little human oversight as possible, as this is necessary to achieve the desired level of autonomy. Conversely, this level of autonomy has seen AI agents bypass guardrails to complete their tasks. Government intelligence agencies have also been known to penetrate target networks through civilian infrastructure. “The target may well be hit. But what path will it take?” asked Hyrum Anderson, co-founder and CEO of the AI security firm Abundant, as quoted by The Intercept. “Will it go through a U.S. water utility on its way, because that’s where the adversary has staged its command and control, and take that down too?”
Another angle of concern is how the agents would make judgment calls. While AI agents are excellent at overcoming obstacles in their path, there's no predicting with 100% accuracy what they would consider obstacles or what path they would take to overcome them. “One of the reasons that we trust 19-year-old Marine corporals in Ramadi with live rounds and a weapon is because they have both the compute substrate — the brain and the eyes — but the deep world knowledge to understand, ‘Yeah, I probably shouldn’t do that,’” said William Marcellino, a senior behavioral scientist at the RAND Corporation researching military AI applications. “That is not something that current public AI technology has.”
The ECHOTRIBBLE program is in the early prototyping and industry assessment phase and is led by ARCYBER, the Army Cyber Technology and Innovation Center (ArCTIC), and the Cyber Fusion Innovation Center (CFIC), with private vendors and academic researchers proposing and designing the software. ARCYBER and ArCTIC dictate the operational requirements and rules of engagement, while CFIC, a defense non-profit organization, acts as an intermediary between the Army and commercial tech companies. The Army recently held a virtual Assessment Event from October 6 to October 8, 2026, where it evaluated 65 technical whitepapers submitted by private vendors proposing solutions for the agentic framework and narrowed them to five. The final candidate(s) will be issued funding and formal prototype contracts.

articles.title: 苹果大举押注美国制造！iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone Duo近100种零件来自美国
articles.text:
快科技10月20日消息，今日，苹果宣布进一步扩大美国本土供应链，与多家美国企业合作，为iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone Duo生产关键材料及零部件。
苹果表示，目前iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone Duo已有近100种零件由美国企业生产，供应商遍布美国十多个州，涉及无线通信芯片、半导体器件等多个领域。
此次新增的合作伙伴包括钛金属制造商Perryman Company和电子材料供应商Qnity Electronics。
其中，Perryman将为苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo供应5级钛合金，用于制造机身外壳。
苹果计划未来三年向Perryman投入最多1亿美元，该公司将在美国宾夕法尼亚州的工厂完成钛金属熔炼、锻造和轧制等工序，所用材料中再生钛含量不低于80%。
另一家合作伙伴Qnity Electronics则将为iPhone 18 Pro的可变光圈镜头提供关键薄膜材料。
除了新增合作伙伴，苹果还披露了现有美国供应商的最新进展。
博通将在美国生产先进射频组件，根据双方多年期合作计划，预计将生产超过150亿颗美国制造的芯片。
康宁则负责生产包括超瓷晶面板在内的特种玻璃，苹果表示，到2026年底，全球销售的iPhone和Apple Watch所使用的盖板玻璃都将在康宁位于美国肯塔基州的工厂生产。
与此同时，台积电位于美国亚利桑那州的工厂也在持续扩大产能，预计2026年将为苹果生产超过1亿颗芯片，用于iPhone、iPad及Apple Watch等产品。
据了解，苹果此前宣布，计划在四年内向美国制造业及创新领域投入6000亿美元，此次扩大本土供应链合作，也是其推进美国制造计划的重要举措。

articles.title: Announcements and highlights from Google Public Sector Summit 2026
articles.text:
Today we are bringing together mission leaders and builders from across the public sector at the Google Public Sector Summit in Washington D.C. to explore a critical intersection: Where mission meets moonshot. Through our hands-on programming, we will offer inspiration as well as pragmatic steps for turning moonshot aspirations into secure, scaled, real-world outcomes.
From mapping the human genome to putting a human on the moon, public sector organizations have been at the helm of some of humanity’s most historic breakthroughs. Right now, public sector leaders are being asked to move faster than ever, amidst more complexity and uncertainty, often with fewer resources than the mission demands. To better understand these challenges and opportunities, we surveyed several hundred leaders from across the public sector with theCUBE and ECI Research. According to the findings, while 96.3% of agencies have deployed agents in some form, only 9% have achieved agency-wide adoption. The bottleneck isn’t a lack of vision or ambition—it is the systemic friction of legacy data silos and integration complexity. That is why so many organizations turn to Google; we deliver powerful technology that reduces the toil of getting started, minimizes the friction of integration, and provides the secure foundation for scale.
To that end, we are excited to share several new announcements and capabilities to support your missions and moonshots in the agentic era.
Introducing the Gemini agent
We recently announced the Gemini agent: your new single, universal agent for work. It can have all of your organizational context and can be used for everything from knowledge work to answering questions, and from content creation to coding, all from a single prompt box. At your direction, it can plan the work, use skills and tools, connect to your systems, and bring back something finished — inside the documents, the inbox, and the developer environments you already work in and give it permissions for. With your guidance, the agent chooses the best model for the job, employs built-in cost controls, and most importantly, reflects the security, administration, and governance controls established by your organization.
Introducing Gemini for government services
This morning we launched Gemini for government services in private preview, a purpose-built platform engineered for the security, governance, and workflow complexity of public sector missions. Built around the core promise of delivering "less paperwork, more public service," it provides an integrated, fully governed environment configured for rapid deployment across federal, state, and local agencies. By combining pre-built partner agents, secure connectors, and deterministic skills, the platform enables civil servants to securely link Gemini directly to existing case management, ERP, and agency collaboration systems of record without migrating their agencies’ sensitive data. Civil servants are empowered to automate repetitive, high-stakes tasks—such as public records requests, document intake validation, expense auditing, and policy research—all grounded in authoritative federal regulatory sources with verifiable citations. Learn more about Gemini for government services in our blog post.
Introducing Wiz agents in Wiz for Gov
The Wiz Red, Green, and Blue agents are now available within Wiz for Gov, Wiz’s FedRAMP Class D (High) certified environment. The expansion of the agent trio into Wiz for Gov accelerates remediation for critical public sector priorities, including Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). The Green Agent can assist in driving PQC readiness through a new risk type dedicated to weak cryptography that investigates whether an asset is quantum-vulnerable and assesses potential Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) exposure. By leveraging the cryptographic visibility from code to runtime gained through the Wiz AI-APP, the Wiz Green Agent is able to help weigh real-world external reachability against data sensitivity enabling delivery of continuously updated, PQC-resistant fixes directly into developer workflows.
Wiz has also invested in several other initiatives intended to benefit the public sector. Scan for Good, a program launched jointly by Wiz and Google DeepMind, uses the Wiz Red Agent and Gemini 4 Argon, alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, to provide no-cost security assessments designed to uncover high-risk vulnerabilities and exposures across eligible public services, critical infrastructure, and other under-resourced organizations. Wiz is also expanding capabilities for organizations navigating the new FedRAMP Vulnerability Detection and Response (VDR) and Vulnerability Evaluation and Reporting (VER) rulesets. This includes operationalizing critical FedRAMP metrics, including Potential Agency Impact (PAIN), and validating likely exploitability (LEV) and internet reachability (IRV). These enhancements will assist organizations seeking to achieve or maintain FedRAMP certification with the automated reporting and prioritized risk assessment required.
Bringing enterprise search capabilities to Gemini on Google Distributed Cloud
For defense, intelligence, and national security agencies operating in classified environments, the challenge is not just analyzing vast volumes of sensitive data, it is doing so without compromising perimeter security. To help turn classified information into actionable intelligence, we are bringing enterprise search capabilities to Gemini on Google Distributed Cloud for air-gapped deployments. With this new capability, users gain an intuitive conversational interface to query, synthesize, and summarize records at machine speed, completely disconnected from the public internet. This launch brings Gemini 3.5 Flash models to on-premises air-gapped deployments, expands model flexibility with open models like Gemma, and delivers massive local compute through generally available NVIDIA Blackwell B300 GPUs.
Driving mission impact, together
Through partnership and powerful technology, organizations across the public sector are transforming how services are delivered, accelerating research and science, strengthening national security, improving healthcare delivery, and enhancing student outcomes. These organizations aren’t waiting for the future; they are actively building it right now.
America.gov is offering a streamlined "front door" that simplifies access to federal services online. Google is proud to be named a technology partner in this vital initiative, leveraging Gemini to help millions of Americans access critical public resources with greater speed and ease.
SUNY is tackling challenges with direct impact for communities across New York and beyond. Together, we are ​​empowering researchers of all technical backgrounds to easily access and benefit from Google Cloud's advanced capabilities—bringing storage, high-powered computing, Gemini Enterprise, and more than 200 trusted models together into a seamless, centralized ecosystem.
The Department of Energy is accelerating breakthroughs in energy dominance, discovery science, and national security through the Genesis Mission. Gemini will support the full breadth of work - from the research bench to specialized user facilities – building a secure foundation that the DOE mission can depend on.
The U.S. Army is leading a sweeping modernization of its logistics infrastructure including non-tactical logistics networks, supply chain procedures, and organic industrial base sites. The Army's Strategic Capital Initiative will pair Google's secure cloud and FedEx's logistics expertise to build a more intelligent and connected supply chain network that helps reduce delivery times and ensures personnel receive the critical equipment where and when they need it.
The Department of War is supercharging daily operations and workflows with Gemini, giving 3 million personnel across the department access to a secure enterprise-grade platform. With Agent Designer, GenAI.mil users are quickly able to build their own agents using natural language to help streamline repetitive, multi-step tasks such as document creation and document reviews.
Case Western Reserve University is improving learning outcomes and accelerating research breakthroughs. They are leveraging Gemini for education campus-wide, transforming the experience of every scientist, staff member, and student. Tomorrow, they’re opening a new hub for discovery and innovation that leverages Google technology, and connects Google engineers with 300 university researchers across campus.
Google Public Sector: Your mission partner
The agentic era will not be defined by what technology can do, but by what we choose to build with it. So let’s meet this moment, let's re-imagine what’s possible, and let’s create impact — together.
Register early for Google Public Sector Summit On-Demand to be notified when the event’s content is published.
Learn how Gemini for government services can help transform critical workflows and advance your mission.
Request a demo to see how the Wiz Agents can help your agency meet today’s security demands at machine speed.
Catch the highlights from Google Public Sector Summit on our Linkedin page, schedule a 1:1 consultation with a Google team member or reach us at geminiforgov@google.com.

articles.title: PC厂商内存荒终于有救了！联想惠普戴尔签长期协议：涨价压力减半
articles.text:
快科技10月20日消息，据报道，联想、惠普、戴尔等主要PC厂商现已与内存制造商完成长期供应协议（LTA，Long-Term Agreement）签署，锁定2027年存储芯片供应，以规避现货市场的价格波动与断供风险。
今年上半年，AI基础设施投资带动内存需求激增，PC厂商在与数据中心客户争夺产能时明显处于下风。
一位PC厂商高管透露，DRAM和固态硬盘的实际到货量仅满足需求的70%至80%，生产计划受到明显冲击。签署LTA后，明年的零部件采购“不会有大问题”。
消费端需求的萎缩，客观上也在缓解供应压力。据Omdia数据，2026年第三季度全球PC出货量同比骤降21%，预计明年再降7%。出货量下滑降低了整体采购需求，供应链调配压力随之减轻。
成本压力虽未消失，但涨幅正在收窄。综合CPU、GPU及存储价格涨幅，业内预测明年PC零部件整体价格将上涨约10%至20%，低于今年的水平。LTA锁定的价格区间，将帮助厂商对冲部分现货涨价风险。
在消费PC持续低迷的背景下，PC厂商正加速将重心从B2C转向B2B。企业AI部署提速与员工设备换机周期叠加，为B2B市场提供了稳定需求。
据Omdia数据，AI PC已占美国市场第二季度出货量的48.3%，第三季度有望突破50%。售价超过1500美元（约合人民币10800元）的高端PC出货量逆势增长36.8%。
一名PC厂商人士表示，明年的核心目标是扩大AI PC产品线、提升供货量，在稳定的零部件供应基础上争夺企业换机订单。从消费端收缩到企业端扩张，PC行业的竞争逻辑正在被重新书写。

articles.title: https://www.anthropic.com/research/claude-code-sandboxing
Language Models are Lazy Poets: Creative Mode Collapse at Scale
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24223v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: While aligned large language models (LLMs) can successfully complete many creative tasks, their outputs tend to be highly self-similar. Though solutions to this problem of "mode collapse" have been proposed, comprehensive large-scale surveys of the phenomenon in specific textual genres are still lacking. We address this gap through an extensive treatment of LLM mode collapse in poetry. Across 15 poetic forms, 248 subject matter tags, and 16 open-weight models, we generate over 1.1 million poems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the largest corpus of LLM-generated poetry to date. At million-poem scale, we find that LLM poetic vocabularies and rhyming abilities are substantial, but severely underutilized. In other words, LLMs are "lazy" poets: despite possessing large poetic inventories, LLMs over-rely on a small number of words, opening phrases, and rhymes. Further, we find that lexical homogenization differs across models and poetic forms, noting observed rhyming vocabulary is correlated with model size.

articles.title: BanglaShield: A Script-Robust Safety Classifier and Benchmark for Bangla Native, Romanized, and Code-Mixed Prompts
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24288v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Safety classifiers for large language models (LLMs) are typically built and evaluated on standard-script text, yet Bangla, like many lower-resource languages, is routinely written in native script, in Latin-script romanization, and code-mixed with English, Hindi, or Urdu. We introduce BanglaShield, a resource and model for graded prompt-safety classification across these written forms. We consolidate 10,245 Bangla prompts from six sources under a four-level taxonomy (Safe, Offensive, Harmful, Severe) and render each prompt in three aligned forms that share labels and a group-aware split, enabling strictly paired comparisons. Benchmarking six contemporary LLMs, including a Bangla-specialized one, on 36,882 classification queries and 24,318 judged responses, we find that LLM classifiers label 47.0% of unsafe native-script prompts as Safe, rising to 63.4% under romanization, while response-level safety accuracy drops by 10.3 points. Three multilingual guard models also pass 30.3-57.3% of unsafe native-script prompts. Using a model's own classification as an input filter reduces harmful compliance by only about five points. In contrast, BanglaShield, a compact fine-tuned encoder, reaches 87.8 macro-F1 on native-script and 84.4 on romanized prompts, outperforming the best LLM on each form by 42.8-46.1 points with ~130x fewer parameters than Gemma 4 31B. We release the corpus, splits, judgments, and model.

articles.title: 抖音电商公布双11开门红数据：消费券带动成交额破亿商家数涨2倍
articles.text:
抖音电商公布2026年双11“开门红”阶段数据报告。报告显示，10月15日至18日大促“开门红”阶段，平台上消费券带动成交额破亿的商家数量同比增长200%。平台出资消费券与分层扶持政策共同发力，助力不同发展阶段商家在大促开局实现生意增长；店播、特色行业商家和农产品产业带生意集中爆发。
平台全资消费券，助力不同阶段商家生意爆发
报告显示，开门红期间平台出资消费券持续带动商家生意增长。10月15日至18日，由消费券带动的、成交额破百万元商家数量同比增长38%，破千万元的商家数量同比增长36%，破亿元的商家数量同比增长200%。平台出资消费券让利消费者，也为商家承接大促生意提供助力。
今年双11，抖音电商延续分层扶持策略，帮助中小新商从开店、动销到经营规模稳步成长。数据显示，开门红期间，成交额新突破百万元的商家数量同比增长59%，成交额从百万元增长到千万元的商家数量同比增长78%，成交额破亿元的直播间数量同比增长80%。
店播仍是商家生意增长的重要引擎。报告显示，开门红期间，店播成交额破千万的新商数量同比增长133%，成交额破千万的店播直播间数量同比增长98%。新商家入局店播，借助大促迎来新机会。
直播间种草特色优质商品，多行业跑出新增量
特色行业在开门红期间集中爆发。数据显示，农产品生鲜行业成交额过千万商家数量同比增长250%，宠物行业成交额过千万商家数量同比增长200%，母婴行业成交额过千万商家数量同比增长83%，快消行业成交破亿品牌数量同比增长167%。
直播间持续种草特色好物、风味农产，助力产业带商家接住新增量。开门红期间，成交额TOP5农产品和生鲜产业带包括江苏大闸蟹、黑龙江五常大米、陕西徐香猕猴桃、浙江舟山带鱼、福建乌龙茶，产业带特色风味物产成为大促中的增长亮点。宠物行业产业带商家同样迎来快速增长。开门红期间，成交额增长TOP5宠物食品行业产业带商家所在地包括浙江绍兴、广东佛山、吉林白城、浙江嘉兴、山东枣庄。
抖音电商相关负责人表示，不管是平台出资消费券，还是面向不同发展阶段商家的扶持策略，抖音电商希望借助大促节点，让更多中小商家获取更多实实在在的生意增长。

articles.title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24722v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

articles.title: 设计师的第一个 Personal Agent，可能就是 Lovart 2.0 的 Arti 了
articles.text:
2025 年，Lovart 作为全球首款设计 Agent 开始出现在各大设计师社区。第一次用 AI 能力把整个设计流程串联起来。从最初的设计思路、到最终图片或视频的设计物料，终于被完整的放到一块画布上完成。
随着在生成能力和指令遵循程度上的进步，AI 越发能够满足人们现实世界的真实需求，muse 此时带起关于 personal agent 的讨论显得恰逢其时。AI 在能力上已经具备了可观的解决问题的能力，下一步就是如何个性化的解决「我」的问题，以及更主动的解决问题。
放到设计里，Personal Agent 带来了一些新的想象力。比如一套物料做完，下一个项目还会来。设计师喜欢什么配色、哪些版式已被否过，总不能每次开工都重新交代，那它能否持续性的理解设计师的风格变化？又或者设计前期调研、每周做一批物料这些日常的重复性工作，能不能也交代一次，让 AI 往后按时做？
这些事决定了，眼下 AI 能把设计这件事推动到什么地步。
设计体系里，到现在用过 Lovart 的专业创作者已经达到数千万，它或许是当下最适合回答这个问题的，在迭代到 Lovart 2.0 后，它拿出了全球首个个人设计 agent——Arti。
01
Arti，个人设计 Agent
Arti 不只是一个工具，而是一个真正接住完整设计工作的个人设计 Agent。
你交给它一个完整的设计需求，它不只负责生成，还会主动去调研、找参考。甚至它会查看画布检查信息有没有遗漏、排版有哪些地方需要调整，并根据你的反馈继续修改。这当中反复出现的工作也会被整理成 Skill，下次再遇到相似的需求，它就能沿用这些做法，省下重新交代和重复操作的工夫。
但在这之前，Arti 在设计领域首先要迈过的门槛，是对于设计师的个人风格和设计 taste 的理解。这也是为什么 Arti 是从「记忆」功能诞生的。
进入 Arti 的第一件事，是告诉 Agent 你是谁。
你需要先告诉 Arti 你从事的领域，比如电商、营销、内容创作或者其他的行业，然后就会进入下一步更细致的询问页面——我第一次体验 Arti 的时候正好有一位在日化消费品牌做过设计师的朋友坐在旁边，所以我借着他的人设，选择的是电商。
Arti 会问的非常细节，除了主要做的设计物料种类，还会询问我作为设计师的身份，是甲方、乙方或者接单的独立设计师。对应不同场景下，Arti 和设计师有着不同的协同方式，这些它都考虑进去了。
确定了协同方式之后，之后是确定审美偏好这一步。
先选择一种默认的审美偏向是意料之中的，但让人意外的是 Arti 有一个问题是「哪些情况不按默认风格来？」。坐在我旁边做过电商公司设计师的朋友看到了眼泪要喷出来了——「平台强制规范、合作限定...... 这个 Arti 知道我们设计师的苦。」
一系列问询题目的答案结合后会成为设计师个性化 Arti 的起点，但这些肯定不足以说明一位设计师的 taste，所以在页面最下方的「常用资产」一栏，你可以直接把自己以前的设计稿、文档或者海报放进去，更直接的让 Arti 来理解你的风格和偏好。
当然，除了提供你在 Arti 之外的设计素材，你也可以把之前在 Arti 或者 Lovart 上做的设计放进去成为未来的参考。Arti 是一个极具成长性的 Agent，记忆是成长的原点，你每一次在 Arti 中发生的成功或失败的创作，都会推动你的 Arti 持续进化。
02
最怕懂我的人还主动
和所有设计类的 Agent 不同的是，Arti 更像是一个有完整设计领域经验的 Personal AI。Personal AI 的概念是一套新的技术栈的封装组合出的新的产品形态，而 Arti 更像是把这个新的产品形态里一些最重要的特质做了单独强化——比如对于主动性的重视。
这意味着它会更主动的参与整个设计流程前、中、后期。那些设计工作流里最痛苦的事，最渴望甩给一个经验点满的高精力同事分担的工作，现在 Arti 可以一个不落的都主动接过去。
设计方法的前期工作里，最巨大的工作量，毫无疑问是调研和找那些参考。
拿到一个新的设计项目时，也同时会拿到需求方的更多背景要求和表达偏好，这意味着在它落到最终确定的设计方案之前，有许多关于背景资料调研、风格参考的案头工作。
拿我身边这位消费品公司的设计师亲身经历举个例子。他在画电商大促的第一张海报前，得先弄清卖给谁、主推什么、优惠怎么讲，再翻竞品店铺和往期活动，比较主视觉、商品摆放、价格与赠品的呈现方式。
随后在花瓣、Pinterest 等平台反复换关键词，找配色、字体、构图、光影和场景参考，下载、归类、拆解，拼成情绪板。每张参考还得判断：是否符合品牌，能否突出卖点，放不放得下促销文案，能不能延展到首页、横幅和商品主图。甚至看中的配色、构图和材质，可能分散在不同案例里，组合起来又未必协调。
现在 Arti 会主动把这个活儿接过来。你可以在项目对话框中直接唤起 Arti，让它以当前对话中你给出的调研背景和参考素材来做全面调研。
举个例子，我现在想做一个攀岩品牌的电商大促的物料设计方案，我给了它一些设计语言的关键词和一些参考图片，它给了我几个可行的大方向，我选择了其中一个方案然后叫 Arti 帮我调研一下这个方案更多细节的考量。
Arti 的调研还挺细致，从主 KV 的几个核心意象的大小比例、色调的选择以及文字信息的设计几个方面都做了分析，并且让我很意外的是它主动找到了一个攀岩品牌 Black Diamond 的品牌海报来做了参考。
这份调研报告可以直接被转进项目对话里（你也可以继续优化或者提出更多的调研需求），进一步充实这个设计方案的背景往下推进。
调研是设计前期的部分，更大的工作量是在真正进入设计流程后。
设计师们期待 AI 能够让设计物料这件事走上福特生产线，但一旦碰到复杂的设计场景，或者要围绕一个确定的设计语言出多种物料设计，AI 在长对话、多轮修改中就会暴露出对上下文理解的不遵循，问题落到生产出的物料上就是风格的严重不统一。
这是设计师在使用 AI 时最大的卡点之一，而 Arti 会在整个画布层面上来自动检查风格一致性与规范。
上面这个攀岩的设计方案往下推进后，我让 Arti 试着出几个适合电商平台 banner 风格的设计海报，之后把设计海报先收敛在电商首页 banner 位的时候，Arti 发现其中有一张海报不是电商首页 banner 的 3:1 比例。它在对话中发现了这一点，并且提示可以一键调整尺寸。
没有一击即中的设计，在最终定稿之前，每一版的设计物料都会有需求方或者自己团队来的修改意见。一个好的设计 Agent 当然也要了解这一点。所以 Arti 把多轮的反馈改稿这件事也自动化了。
Arti 最适合的打开方式，或许是把它理解成一个能够多方协同的在线设计 Agent。Arti 支持他人在画布上评论修改意见，然后它可以自动的汇总，进一步理解这些修改意见并且提出具体的优化方案，之后我要做的，只是把这个方案放回项目的对话框，然后执行这些改进动作即可。
而设计师在画布上的每一次设计操作，都会在 Arit 的进化日志中被记录下来。当它察觉到你在反复在执行一些相似的设计流程，比如服装上新时模特上身的参考图，或者电子产品上新时的多角度特写，Arti 可以从你的操作和产出中总结出确定的设计思路，自动沉淀为可复用的 Skill。
以服装、鞋类产品的模特上身图举个例子，在我反复做过几次后，这一整套设计流程就会在 Arti 个人主页的「我学会的」里出现。再有类似的设计需求，只需要把新的产品图放入参考背景，然后直接唤起这套流程即可。当然，你可以在」管理技能」中继续优化这一套流程，以及微调一些需要改动的环节。
带着做一遍，然后同类型的活儿都可以交给它——这简直是每个设计师梦想中的完美实习生。但这可能是实习生的极限，不是 Arit 的极限。
03
一个能够自驱动的设计助手
做设计的朋友一直在我电脑旁边看着我演示。我问他，要是不设条件，你最想要一个什么样的设计 Agent ?
「一个能力和审美完全复刻我，但又不厌倦上班，啥事不往心里去，有无限精力和创作激情的，直接帮我把所有活儿干了的助手。」
养熟了之后，完全让他自己干活——这其实要比刚才提到的 Arti 已经体现出的每项单独能力都更复杂。但这件事 Arti 也已经在做了，叫「设计委托」。
创建一个设计委托，输入具体的设计指令和参考素材，设定好执行时间和频率，就可以让 Arit 来自主推进设计方案，无论是批量生成、重复处理还是多任务工作，都可以经过一次委托，省去反复操作和等待的时间。
我试了试把刚才攀岩的海报设计需求放入设计委托，新的海报设计会准时在拟定的时间点出现在个人项目页上。
委托的执行当然也会消耗积分，所以在一开始新建委托时你需要设定好积分消耗上限。而根据使用者对这个设计委托在各个层面的考量，你可以灵活的选择是用「快速」、「均衡」或者更强的「专家」模式来执行你的委托。这意味着或许一整个设计团队，都可以合理的通过 Arti 的设计委托来提效。
「专家」模式可以在图片和视频生成上达到 4k 的水准，并且具备复杂规划的能力，创意团队可以应付那些非常精细的核心设计物料；运营团队需要结合不同场景的产品图来大批量的铺设，或者需要围绕一个 IP 形象大批量的出图，则可以通过在质量和速度之间更加平衡的「均衡」模式来执行；而营销环节中那些图片和视频之外的文案灵感收集和创作，「快速」模式就可以应付了。
拿最近的双 11 举个例子，比如双 11 主视觉定稿了。接下来的需求是：42 个 SKU，每个要出淘宝主图、详情页头图、小红书封面、朋友圈海报四个尺寸，一共 168 张图。你可以把它拆成一个更明确的设计委托：
按项目里已确认的双 11 主视觉风格（上传主视觉），为附件表格中的 42 个 SKU 批量生成四种尺寸的物料：淘宝主图 800×800、详情页头图、小红书封面 3:4、朋友圈海报 9:16。保持主视觉的配色、字体和版式，商品图替换为对应 SKU，价格与卖点。
设置成单词执行，晚上 10 点开始，先跑四个 SKU 确认效果。你就可以得到一个类似下图的 case，在确认好样式后，就让他一晚上慢慢做那 168 张图，第二天起来验收即可。
但实话说我刚点开委托创建页面时一上手还是有点懵的。所以不知道要怎么给出指令的话，设计委托创建页面上提供了 16 种不同设计需求的领域模版，基本覆盖了目前最主要的设计需求。你可以在这些模版的基础上修改，或许能更准确的表达自己的设计需求。
我试了试「灵感参考收集」的模版，然后把模版里的主题改成了北欧户外攀岩——我应该会在 Arti 上常设一个每日固定收集图片素材的设计委托了。
上下游环节极多且涉及所有模态的设计行业，或许是 AI 能力最综合的试验场。
从 Midjourney 到 Sora 再到 Seedance，多模态生成能力能够满足更广泛的设计需求，设计行业对 AI 的要求开始转变成能否系统性的闭环整个设计链路。到了 personal Agent 的阶段，AI 开始具备主动性，有潜力成为一个真正能够自我成长的设计助手。
这也是为什么在从头到尾试了一遍 Arti 之后会有一些感觉，Lovart 这次的迭代与其说瞄着设计这件事本身，不如说是在瞄着设计师。
设计是一个庞大工业，有太多事情在遮挡一个设计师充分发挥创意。大量的案头准备、真实场景下的重复劳动，多方协同过程中的信息差，或许才是设计师眼前最主要的工作内容。
AI 能把设计这件事推动到什么地步，要看 AI 能多大程度把设计师从这些场景里解放出来。
如果说 Lovart 1.0 开始把整套设计流程放进一块画布，那 Lovart 2.0 和 Arti 所希望的，或许是设计师可以暂时离开这块画布了。

+You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API. 12-hour prompt caching keeps shared instructions, tools, and context cached longer to benefit from lower cached-input pricing, even when requests are hours apart. 12-hour cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price. Read more here.

+OpenAI-hosted sandboxes in the Agents API now include the Artifact SDK and skills for creating and editing spreadsheets, presentations, and Word documents.

+Oct 9
+Feature
+v1/agents
+You can now pre-warm an OpenAI-hosted sandbox before attaching it to an Agents API session. Prewarming improves latency by creating and configuring the sandbox before a user finishes sending their message. This means the user doesn't have to wait for all this work to complete.
+OpenAI-hosted sandbox compute is now billed during active turns. You no longer pay for idle time between turns.

articles.title: Vocal-Tract Acoustics, Aerodynamics, and Overlap-and-Add Synthesis in DYNARTmo
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24490v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This paper presents the acoustic and aerodynamic extension of DYNARTmo, a dynamic articulatory model for visualizing and synthesizing speech production. Gestural control trajectories determine vocal-tract geometry, which is converted into an acoustic tube with nasal branching and effective lateral passages. A lumped aerodynamic network relates prescribed glottal motion and pulmonary pressure to airflow and supraglottal pressure storage. Phonatory excitation, oral friction, and glottal aspiration are synthesized as separate contributions. Frame-specific acoustic responses are combined by overlap-and-add, preserving response tails beyond individual control frames. Three German words, ``Tasse'', ``Muse'', and ``Lade'', illustrate the coordination of articulation, pressure, flow, and acoustic sources across vowels, nasals, laterals, fricatives, and plosives. The implementation has been optimized by the author primarily for sound recognizability; independent perceptual evaluation remains outstanding, and fricative-noise naturalness requires further refinement. The model provides an inspectable, articulatorily controlled production plant for future neural simulations of babbling, imitation, and early word acquisition. Further work will improve acoustic realism, reduce empirical source corrections, and extend the sensory information available to developmental learning models.

articles.title: 用AMD就不让参会！英伟达对小型云厂商下封杀令：用了竞品芯片就别来
articles.text:
快科技10月20日消息，据半导体研究机构SemiAnalysis近日披露，英伟达已拒绝多家新兴云服务商（NeoCloud）参加即将在柏林举行的GTC大会。原因并非技术不达标，而是这些厂商在自己的云平台上引入了AMD GPU、Google TPU等竞品芯片。
SemiAnalysis证实了这一消息，但未公布被拒厂商的具体名单。英伟达方面对此尚未公开置评。不过，事件的核心信息已经足够清晰：在英伟达主导的AI算力生态里，使用竞争对手的芯片，正在成为一条不可触碰的红线。
这种控制力建立在深度绑定的商业关系之上。对于CoreWeave、Nebius这类新兴云厂商，英伟达不仅是芯片供应商，更是重要的投资方和融资背书者。
英伟达今年已向CoreWeave和Nebius各战略投资20亿美元，并为其算力租赁提供收入兜底。这意味着，一旦失去英伟达的支持，这些公司的融资能力和设备获取都会受到直接影响。
因此，尽管部分厂商已经在向客户提供AMD和Google的加速器，却普遍选择低调处理，避免公开触怒这位掌握着产能与资金双重话语权的供应商。
有云厂商高管坦言，他们担心采购竞品会导致英伟达削减最新GPU的优先供应，甚至影响公司未来的融资或上市计划。
值得注意的是，这种压力并不适用于微软、亚马逊、谷歌等超大规模云厂商。它们拥有足够的采购体量和自研芯片能力，在与英伟达的博弈中拥有更大的回旋余地。真正被夹在中间的，是那些体量有限、却又被英伟达视为生态关键一环的新兴云服务商。
从CUDA生态到资本纽带，英伟达正在用多重手段加固自己的护城河。但当“用竞品就出局”的规则变得如此直白，反垄断的阴影不知会不会随之而来。

articles.title: 好价正当时！双11华为平板这样买，15%国补再叠教育优惠超值入手
articles.text:
双11大促拉开序幕，电子设备迎来换新高峰，「双11平板选购指南」「学生党平板推荐」「2026年哪些办公产品值得买」等话题成为消费者热议的焦点。现在用户选购平板和笔记本，早已不只是为了观影娱乐，无纸化学习、移动办公、专业绘画创作，都成了核心的使用诉求。
面对更加多元的需求，华为MatePad系列凭借鸿蒙AI、原生PC应用生态及全面的专业创作流能力，为不同人群提供了更丰富的选择。恰逢双11，华为平板还推出限时优惠，符合条件的用户可享教育优惠、国家补贴等购机权益，也让这波大促成为入手华为平板的好时机。
重度办公与创作，就选华为MatePad Pro系列
买一台平板，最初可能只是为了看课件、记笔记。学生党开始查文献、写论文，职场人需要根据会议批注修改方案，常用软件能否打开、键鼠操作是否顺手，就成了每天都会遇到的问题。今年双11，华为MatePad Pro系列的原生PC应用持续上新，鸿蒙双桌面也让手写记录之后的编辑、排版有了更熟悉的操作方式。
目前，华为MatePad Pro系列支持近400款原生PC应用，华为MatePad Pro Max与华为MatePad Pro 12英寸持续新增130余款，自由多窗支持100余款PC应用，各类AI办公应用也已上线，可辅助整理资料、起草文档。做课题研究时，在CAJ Viewer中读文献，用万兴脑图梳理观点，再到WPS Office中编辑报告，已经覆盖了日常工作中的这些具体任务。

articles.title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24663v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At k=256, it solves 67.5% of the problems, significantly more than the RL model (61.4%) and a mixture of whole responses matched in pass@1 (61.45%). The comparison is at equal attempt counts rather than equal compute, since rl-replace consults both models at every decoding step. These results show that the opening can recover a meaningful part of the RL gain, but a larger contribution comes from later choices, which can be borrowed while retaining much of the base model's diversity. Code is available at https://github.com/CyrusZhang04/WhatRLBrings.

articles.title: https://www.anthropic.com/research/building-c-compiler
MisleadQA: Diagnosing LLM Failures under Misleading Context
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24851v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer questions from retrieved or user-provided context. However, provided context can be factually true yet out-of-scope, describing a different entity, time, or location from the one the question targets, and still lead models to a wrong answer. Prior work has mainly studied factually false or irrelevant context. It remains unclear whether such out-of-scope context misleads models as much as false context, and whether adding gold context prevents models from being misled by either. We introduce **MisleadQA**, a diagnostic dataset of multiple-choice questions with an abstention option. Each question pairs gold context (G) with true but out-of-scope context (S) and false but in-scope context (F) supporting the same wrong answer. We evaluate six open-weight LLMs. On questions they answer correctly without context, providing S alone leads them to switch to this wrong answer in 29.3% of cases, and providing F alone does so in 75.4%. Adding G nearly removes the effect of S, but F still misleads models in 21.0% of cases, especially when F comes first. A context-faithful instruction reduces these errors mainly through abstention and lowers accuracy even with G. These findings suggest that evaluations should check whether context applies to the question, not only whether it is true, and should report correct, misled, and abstention rates together. Data and code are available at [https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA).

articles.title: Beyond Clean Accuracy: The Practical Challenges and Benefits of Pixel-Based Language Models
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24290v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Pixel-based language models process rendered text without relying on a fixed subword vocabulary, offering a promising approach to noisy and multilingual inputs. However, their practical value depends on whether they can be reliably adapted to downstream tasks. To this end, we systematically examine this question through fine-tuning behavior, typographical robustness, and zero-shot crosslingual transfer. Under our tested settings, pixel-based models require longer training and broader labelled-data coverage than text-based models, while delayed learning and learning-rate-dependent failures make adaptation less reliable. Our analyses further suggest that task-relevant information is less readily accessible in pretrained pixel representations, placing greater demands on fine-tuning. Once successfully adapted, however, pixel-based models lose substantially less accuracy under typographical noise and achieve higher target-language accuracy than English-pretrained text-based counterparts on two crosslingual benchmarks, despite weaker clean English performance. Together, these findings reveal a central trade-off: replacing tokenization with rendering reduces sensitivity to corrupted and unfamiliar inputs, but shifts a central bottleneck to downstream adaptation.

articles.title: 昨天还在互撕的产品经理，今天全被REA逼成了战友
articles.text:
（本文作者为 字母AI，钛媒体经授权发布）
文 | 字母AI
各个App的产品经理们总是水火不容，“你的UI是垃圾”、“这交互是给人用的？”、“你是伪用户视角，拿少数用户个案代表全量”。
可当REA爆火之后，这群产品经理们一瞬间就完成了战线统一，一致对抗REA。
产品是这群产品经理们的命脉，有了REA，这些产品的护城河几乎荡然无存。
法国技术博主Korben用Opus 5.5对REA进行实测。
他让Agent读取自己写的一个crackme程序的伪代码，大约2分钟，Agent就写出了能通过验证的Python keygen，API成本仅为大约0.5美元。他随后用479个随机用户名做了验证，全部通过。
一个功能从提需求、排期、开发、测试到上线，动辄几个礼拜甚至几个月。可REA只要几分钟就给反编译了，这搁谁谁也受不了。
具体是怎么反 REA 的？
由于REA包含了市面上所有的逆向软件，再加上AI，因此怎么设计产品都不能保证100%不会被反编译。
既然挡不住，产品经理们就开始了抱团想对策。
最朴素也最有效的做法，是不在客户端放密钥和隐藏接口。
过去很多产品会把一些“反正用户看不到”的东西塞进安装包。这其中就包括写死的密钥、内部接口、只在客户端做的权限校验、靠前端判断的会员状态。而这些东西在REA面前，就等于是“裸奔”。
逆向教材《Practical Reverse Engineering》作者之一的埃利亚斯·巴沙拉尼（Elias Bachaalany）就表示，唯一稳妥的办法，是把关键逻辑放到服务器上。
所以这群产品经理按照埃利亚斯的方法，把值钱的东西搬出客户端。
尤其是把信任决策放回服务端。用户有没有付费、能不能访问某个功能、这次请求合不合法，都不再由客户端说了算，而是每次都去问服务器。
随后，产品经理们将核心逻辑上云。推荐算法、定价策略、风控规则、关键的数据处理，只让客户端拿到结果，拿不到过程。
这三步合在一起，客户端慢慢变成了一个“只有界面的外壳”。外壳可以被拆，被复刻，但里面没有东西。
但是有些场景是没法搬到云端的，比如嵌入式设备和游戏，这些都只能在本地运行。
于是产品经理们开始商量第二套办法，他们对代码加壳、混淆、虚拟化保护和反调试，让REA最先逆向出来的玩意是“假的”。
虽然到最后REA还是能逆向完整的产品，但是这会让整个逆向过程变得费劲。
一些厂商也盯上了这门生意。REA爆火后，Thales发布Sentinel Envelope Plus，官方称之为专门针对AI逆向的保护方案，可以在不改源码的情况下，对应用的指定部分做多层的反反编译、防篡改和防运行时检查。
Thales还公布了一组受控测试：对于未保护的应用，AI Agent找出了10个漏洞中的8个；加上保护之后Agent一个都没找到，token消耗是之前的970倍，最后Agent自己建议放弃分析。
对产品加强防护之余，产品经理们还互相分享方法，在Discord上创建了反REA频道，专门给那些不知道怎么对付REA的产品经理传授方法。
其中最常被引用的，是安全公司Quarkslab在8月发表的文章《Defeating AI-Assisted Reverse Engineering (or at Least Trying To)》。
这篇文章的核心发现是：现代混淆可以让反编译结果在结构上看起来合理，实际上却不反映程序的真实行为，从而把AI带离“容易的路径”，让它得出看似合理但并不正确的判断。
这个思路最有意思的地方在于，过去混淆是为了让人“看不懂”，现在更重要的是让AI“看错”。
面对一个完全看不懂的程序，Agent会老实承认他看不懂。可一个看起来逻辑通顺的错误答案，才是对付AI的最好办法，因为Agent不会停下来质疑它。
产品经理们“统一战线”，其实更像一种无奈。归根结底，谁也没法让自己的客户端变得不可逆向，只能减缓逆向它的过程，增加逆向它的成本。
质疑与谩骂接踵而至
REA狂欢过后，留下的是一地鸡毛。
埃利亚斯在REA刷屏后对其评价为：hype（炒作）。社区给出的证据是，REA的星标增速远超过它的下载量，也就是所谓的“drive-by stars”，点了星标但没真正用。
随后埃利亚斯列出了一串早就存在的同类工具。埃利亚斯表示，诸如GhidraMCP、IDA Pro MCP这类工具，在2025年就已经实现了用AI进行逆向分析。
IDA Pro MCP插件的作者、x64dbg调试器的开发者邓昆·奥格尔维（Duncan Ogilvie），在只使用IDA Pro MCP的前提下，大约一小时就解完了今年Flare-On逆向挑战赛的题目。也就是说，此前市面上就有比REA更好的逆向插件。
但REA的优势在于，它自己不做反编译，它做的是调度。让Agent去调用Ghidra、IDA和Hopper这些逆向工具，REA自己拿到结果，再去写代码、做测试。在这之中，真正对目标进行逆向分析的，仍然是那些老牌工具加上大模型。
实测方面，评价也不一致。Korben的测试里，REA与不使用REA、直接让Claude配合Ghidra的方案，都完成了四项测试，REA 在一些项目上更快，但在 patch 测试上反而更慢。
还有一个容易被忽略的细节。10月19日的一篇DEV Community实测文章表示，通过记录REA逆向分析所需的环境后发现，Ghidra、JDK等依赖需要用户自己准备。
和上面这些冷静的质疑相比，在独立开发者社区更多的是纯粹的谩骂。独立开发者的研发效率远低于企业团队：企业端产品的开发周期通常在2-3个月，而不少独立开发者的项目往往要打磨数年。
这要是让REA几分钟复制走，那他们心态确实容易崩溃。
10月10日，外网论坛的独立开发者版块就出现了一个爆火的帖子，标题是《Fxxking Hate the whole new trends of “Reverse Engineer Anything”》，大意是“我XXX讨厌这股‘REA’新潮流”。
帖子里没有论述，只有纯粹的谩骂。帖子下面的回复里也充斥着谩骂，独立开发者们把这里当成了情绪的宣泄口。
随后，由于这篇帖子几乎变成了英语脏话宝典，最终导致帖子被整个删除。
愤怒的独立开发者们没有大公司的法务和安全团队，没有预算买Thales那样的保护方案，作品一旦被逆向分析，几个月甚至几年心血就都没了。
专家说它没什么新东西，是炒作，而普通人却觉得它让一切都变了。
就在矛盾之中，更可怕的事情发生了。
已经有木马冒充 REA
任何一个爆火的开源项目，几乎都会引来仿冒者。比如OpenClaw爆火之后，GitHub上面至少有几百个人冒充OpenClaw仓库，骗人点进来，然后给下载这个假OpenClaw仓库的人植入病毒。
REA也不例外。
10月10日，一个名为rea-tools的GitHub组织出现。这个名字，刻意模仿了REA的官方网站rea.tools，让人看一眼就以为这是官方的另一个入口。
仿冒者整份复制官方README，只在里面加了一段“Windows独立版.exe/GUI”的下载说明，指向一个名为“rea-agents: v6.3.0”的Release。
而REA官方的README里根本没有任何安装包，虽然官方仓库的Issue 2136里讨论过是否要做一个一键安装版，然而那只是REA作者的计划，并没有真正发布出来。
REA仿冒者的Release里是一个82.6 MB的压缩包，名为rea-x64.7z。Microsoft Defender把压缩包判为 Trojan:Script/Wacatac.B!ml，解压出的rea-x64.exe判为Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml。VirusTotal上，45个引擎中有8个报毒。
被举报时，这个文件已经被下载了172次。不要忘了，这个病毒是可以二次传播的，所以仿冒者造成的破坏要远远超过已经被曝光的172次。
10月13日，REA的维护者通过PR 2429合并了README警示，明确只认三个入口：github.com/morluto/rea、rea.tools 和 npm 包 rea-agents，并强调“相似的仓库名或复制的README，不能证明下载是官方的”。
道高一尺魔高一丈，仿冒REA的GitHub仓库至今仍屡见不鲜。
仿冒者选中REA，并不奇怪。
第一，套路是现成的。毕竟前面也说了，OpenClaw爆火那时候早就玩过类似的套路了，如今REA爆火，再出现相似的套路一点也不稀奇。
第二，时机。REA的热度在几天内涨了10万星，甚至都不需要REA这三个字，只要靠近这个名字，就能分到流量。
第三，仿冒者递出了官方没有的“方便”。很多用户慕名而来，却并不想自己配Ghidra和JDK，“Windows版安装包”的字眼正好戳中了他们。
第四，也是最要命的一点，那就是REA的用户群，本来就是一群会用Agent的人。他们有MCP、会运行npx，还会给Agent授权。REA在安装过程中，会把它自己注册进Agent的配置，Agent本身又有shell、文件和网络权限。
这就导致REA上携带的病毒，其破坏力要比那些网络上的病毒更大。

articles.title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24556v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable route to studying concepts in language models, potentially extending to millions of features across arbitrary domains.

articles.title: AMD推出智能体AI助手Ross，加速嵌入式系统开发全流程
articles.text:
智东西
作者 | ZeR0
编辑 | 漠影
智东西10月21日报道，近日，AMD推出一款智能体AI助手AMD Ross，旨在加速从架构设计到优化、调试、PCB设计、原理图审查、软件、AI以及实际系统部署的嵌入式开发全流程，相较于典型开发生命周期，可显著加速嵌入式系统的设计、优化、调试和部署。
AMD嵌入式产品涵盖FPGA、自适应SoC、x86嵌入式处理器和专用边缘AI平台，这些均由丰富的开发工具与工作流生态系统提供支持。
AMD Ross支持自然语言工具交互，并可部署由专家开发的智能体技能、可复用工作流和以AMD专业知识为基础的知识库，为整个设计流程提供指导。
它能够连接各类工具、规模化应用专业知识、自动执行经验证且可重复的工作流程，并对结果进行分析，从而帮助工程师快速将设计构想转化为实际实现，同时大幅缩短典型的嵌入式开发周期。
取名Ross，也是为了纪念赛灵思FPGA的创始人Ross Freeman。
开发人员可通过AMD.com/Ross使用AMD Ross。
AMD计划按月在AMD Ross中推出更多AMD嵌入式工具和工作流功能。现可用版本可访问AMD知识库，使用针对FPGA设计的AMD Vivado设计套件和用于算法实现的AMD Vitis HLS工具包。到第四季度，AMD Ross将增加对功耗设计、FPGA调试和AI推理功能的支持。
一、基于AMD工程知识方法论构建，加速嵌入式开发全流程
AMD Ross支持从硬件设计与调试到软件和算法开发、边缘AI实现及部署的整个嵌入式开发过程。
开发者可使用自然语言，让AI智能体搜索文档、检查工具状态、运行命令、指导调试并执行业经验证的工作流。
AMD Ross覆盖全部AMD嵌入式工具产品组合，使用户能够：
进行硬件与软件划分；
实现基于高层次综合工具的硬件设计；
优化芯片设计与调试；
开发嵌入式软件应用和算法；
利用AMD嵌入式AI软件优化机器学习算法；
准确估算功耗并进行低功耗优化；
开展系统原理图审查，并实现最优板级布局。
AMD Ross能提供通用型AI助手无法提供的上下文指导和工作流自动化功能，不受客户端限制，支持团队灵活采用大语言模型、集成开发环境（IDE）和命令行环境，同时与AMD嵌入式开发工具保持连接。
不同于通用型AI助手，AMD Ross基于AMD嵌入式开发环境、AMD长期积累的工程知识体系以及专家编写的方法论构建而成，整合了对AMD开发环境、AMD文档、AMD编写的工作流及可复用工程专业知识的直接访问能力，打造出专为嵌入式开发而设计的体验。
二、4个专属组件：MCP服务器、AMD知识库、智能体技能、设计示例
随着团队同时开展硬件设计与调试、软件开发与部署、AI推理和系统级设计，嵌入式开发正变得日益复杂，工程师有机会简化在整个系统开发生命周期中运用这些资源和成熟工程实践的方式。
通过将专家方法论沉淀为可复用的智能体技能，组织能让专业知识更易获取、提高执行一致性，并使工程师能够专注于更高价值的设计挑战。
AMD Ross汇集了4个专属打造的组件，来为嵌入式开发者提升生产力：
（1）模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器：基于开放标准的MCP服务器，AMD Ross将AI智能体连接到AMD嵌入式工具。借助这一连接，AMD Ross可查询信息、运行命令并在设计环境中工作。
（2）AMD知识库：经AMD验证的向量数据库包含用户指南、产品指南、白皮书、应用笔记和解答记录。其可通过云端或本地离线环境提供经AMD验证的解答和文档访问。
（3）智能体技能：开放且由专家编写的markdown文件，记录针对常见设计任务的可重复、可共享最佳实践。这些技能可以引导大语言模型完成结构化工作流，例如时序优化，或重构C++设计以在Vitis HLS中获得更高性能。
（4）设计示例：可直接运行的设计展示了如何将智能体技能应用于实际嵌入式应用。
▲AMD Ross基础技术栈和智能体工作流
三、AMD Ross能实现什么？原型开发、解决错误、优化设计
AMD Ross旨在加速开发团队从设计构想到部署的进程，包括：
借助AI辅助的工作流自动化，更快完成原型开发；
通过经AMD验证的指导和可复用方法论，缩短调试和优化周期；
通过自动执行重复性的工具交互和任务，提升开发人员生产力；
通过获取经过验证的专家工作流，加快新工程师上手；
在各团队和项目中一致执行最佳实践；
更充分地复用和规模化应用组织内积累的工程知识。
该智能体助手支持的工作流示例包括：
（1）将自然语言意图转化为开发操作：通过搜索文档、执行工具命令、生成代码、迭代设计，并引导开发人员实现设计目标。
一个例子是让Ross创建一个微控制器的设计。Ross会解读设计的意图，为它检测Spartan UltraScale+评估套件创建一个MicroBlaze V微控制器的意图。它会随时进行规划和实现这样的系统，确认连接的电路板，也能帮助解决相关配置不匹配的问题，在连接设计中必要的端口并对其进行配置。整个应用微控制器的预设，包括配置、本地内存，还有时钟及配置子系统等，均由Ross完成。
（2）理解并解决工具错误：通过简化的解释、上下文指导和纠正建议。
（3）分析时序问题：运用AMD时序分析方法论识别时序违例、解释根本原因并提出实现改进建议。
例如，用户在实现时序收敛时遇到了一些困难，Ross可以检查哪些路径出现了失败，按照具体发生的时序失败的类别进行分类，然后分析并验证这些时序失败，确认所有路径均已通过。整个过程都是自动化的，利用了Ross时序智能体技能赋予它的知识和技能。
（4）优化Vitis HLS设计：通过提出有关流水线设计、循环优化、编译指令（pragma）插入和架构改进的建议。
一个例子说明了Ross如何帮助优化算法。这里的应用是一个图像传感器的管线，最初在MATLAB中设计，性能目标是每秒3亿像素。对比手写代码和Ross生成的代码在AMD Vitis上的结果可见，AMD Ross能够达到性能目标，将人类开发者需要花2天时间的任务缩短到2小时内完成，并使得可编程逻辑资源减少35%，也就是实现相同算法所占用的资源减少了35%。
（5）加速硬件调试：通过引导式信号采集、调试核配置、接口分析和根因识别。
AMD Ross可帮助嵌入式开发流程中的系统架构师、电路板设计师、FPGA设计师、嵌入式软件开发人员、算法和AI开发人员等不同角色满足需要；通过汇集AMD各方面的知识，来支持不同功能在一个工作流中帮助分享文件，并把它应用到多个不同的学科，让每个不同的项目角色都能获得相同的技能。这样客户就可以针对每个角色，以情境化上下文的方式来运用这些共享技能或者工作流，了解项目状态。
一个例子是AMD Ross使用多领域的流程，并具备上下文感知能力。这里还用到了一些更高级的AMD Ross功能，比如一个能根据用户提供的技术文档创建基本设计规格的规格生成器，规格创建完成后，Ross能规划工作流程，弄清不同事物之间的关系，以及需要按什么顺序来完成什么样的任务。接下来经过人工审查，就可以在工作流程中执行，通过利用多个不同的智能体，涵盖嵌入开发的各个不同领域。
还有一个例子是上下文感知智能，比如客户需要开发一个基于摄像头的系统且能对设计进行变更，这种设计变更会导致整个系统设计需要更新，也就是会导致FPGA设计接口逻辑需要更新，进而驱动电路板设计和引脚排列发生变更，最终导致软件设计摄像头驱动时序变更。DSP和AI成像流水线也需要变更，导致系统时序需要进行重新校验，整体设计亦需要再次验证。借助AMD Ross，所有流程都可以整合在一起，通过一个可追踪的、可标记和验证的流程来实现，覆盖整个系统层面的设计流程。
在另一个例子中，Ross中的spec生成器可读取用户所提供的规范文档，生成一份spec规格的说明书，然后确定如何在目标硬件中将不同的类型计算资源进行规划和分配，将算法映射到目标硬件上，从而将其转化为一个协调的系统来进行实施和部署。整体验证图像感知就像流水线一样通畅。
结语：访问整个AMD知识库，让开发者更快完成设计
AMD Ross智能体AI助手代表了一种嵌入式开发新方法，将智能体AI、AMD专业知识与业经验证的工作流相结合，有助于团队更高效地开展硬件、软件、AI和系统设计工作。
在智能体工作流的每一个阶段，用户都能自主决定想赋予Ross多少自主权，以及自己想保留多少控制权。
通过使工程知识更易获取和复用，这一智能体助手可助力组织机构加速开发进程、规模化应用专业知识，并更快地将创新产品推向市场。
除了按月增加工具和工具流能力外，AMD还计划通过支持用户定制智能体技能、促进专业工作流共享等方面来推动Ross生态扩展。

articles.title: 硬氪首发｜用AI智能体辅助新材料研发，睿质科技完成数千万元天使轮融资
articles.text:
文｜杨媛
编辑｜彭孝秋
硬氪获悉，北京睿质科技有限公司（以下简称“睿质科技”）近日完成数千万元天使轮融资，本轮由中关村资本领投，中关村科学城公司跟投，中关村产业研究院担任独家财务顾问。目前，公司正在推进新一轮融资。
睿质科技是一家从事AI材料研发软件及平台开发的科技企业，由院士、长江学者团队领衔，主要面向科研机构及工业企业提供材料计算、性能预测和研发服务。
公司目前围绕科研智能体、材料计算和数据管理等方向开发AI材料研发平台，业务涉及先进功能陶瓷、合金、新能源材料等领域。
与直接生产、销售材料的企业不同，睿质科技主要将材料研发过程中的计算模拟、数据分析等能力转化为软件产品和研发服务，供科研机构及工业企业使用。
例如，开发新型合金需要设计不同材料配方，再通过实验测试其性能。材料计算软件则可以在实验之前，对不同配方的结构和性能进行模拟预测，帮助企业研发人员缩小候选范围。
睿质科技提供的正是这类工具和服务。公司希望通过自主研发的Archeos智能体平台，将原本需要科研人员分别完成的方案设计、结构建模、计算分析及数据处理等工作整合起来，减少不同工具之间的切换，并进一步进入工业企业的研发流程。
把材料研发中的计算环节做成产品
在材料研发过程中，从材料配方设计、工艺优化到性能验证，研究人员往往需要使用不同的计算方法和软件工具。由于不同软件的数据格式、计算流程和操作方式存在差异，研究人员通常还需要投入时间完成工具部署、数据转换和计算流程设计。
睿质科技希望通过平台化产品整合这些工作。其核心产品Archeos采用多智能体架构，集成文献检索、材料设计、计算仿真、结果分析及报告生成等功能，将原本分散在不同软件和研发环节中的工作整合起来，使研究人员能够在统一平台上完成更多计算任务。
具体而言，平台将材料研发任务拆分为不同环节，再由相应智能体调用计算工具，完成方案生成、计算执行、结果分析及反馈迭代等工作。例如，在材料性能预测任务中，研究人员可以提出具体研发需求，由平台辅助完成相关资料检索、计算方案设计和模型调用，并对计算结果进行整理和分析。
对于工业客户而言，这类平台的使用价值主要体现在减少重复操作、降低计算工具的使用成本，以及帮助研发人员完成材料设计和性能分析。
从科研成果到工业客户
材料计算平台能否形成商业收入，取决于其能否进入客户的实际研发流程。据公司介绍，在某工业级合金材料性能预测项目中，团队通过整合计算仿真数据、建立机器学习模型，辅助客户开展材料配方选择及性能分析。
对于相关企业而言，提前预测材料性能，可以为材料配方筛选和后续实验设计提供参考。与软件授权相比，定制化项目能够直接对应客户的研发问题，但通常也需要企业投入技术人员完成模型开发、结果分析及项目交付。
睿质科技目前正尝试将两类业务结合起来。一方面，通过Archeos平台向客户提供材料计算及数据分析工具；另一方面，针对企业的具体研发需求，提供定制化计算和技术服务。
在现有软件平台及研发服务之外，睿质科技还计划进一步参与新材料开发。根据公司规划，未来希望将计算模拟与实验验证结合起来，与产业客户联合开展材料研发，并探索技术授权、联合开发及收益分成等商业化方式。

articles.title: Beyond Recall Saturation: Scaling Hard-Negative Reranker Training for Industrial Legal Retrieval
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.24478v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Industrial retrieval systems often improve quality by enlarging embedding candidate pools or adopting complex training pipelines. We show that, under a sufficiently large but practical candidate pool, embedding recall exhibits diminishing returns, motivating a closer examination of reranker quality. On Chinese legal retrieval benchmarks, embedding top-300 reaches a high-recall operating region, while relevant evidence may still be ranked below the output cutoff. We compare hard-negative strategies for reranker training, including embedding-mined, self-mined, and dynamic-negative variants, under aligned retrieval protocols that evaluate reranking after candidate retrieval. Among the evaluated staged configurations, an embedding-to-self-mined pipeline provides a favorable trade-off; additional dynamic stages do not improve all held-out metrics. The selected pipeline scales from a 0.6B to a 4B reranker. Relative to the native 4B reranker, the trained 4B Stage2 model improves reported metrics on the STARD and CSAID benchmarks and on an internal development set, and is preferred in 72.4\% of non-tied comparisons on 410 de-identified, reconstructed internal operational-query inputs in a latency-sensitive offline preference evaluation. These results support evaluating the retrieval and reranking stages separately when selecting an optimization target for industrial retrieval systems.

articles.title: Nscale Joins the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum Member
articles.text:
London, U. K., 20 October 2026 – The PyTorch Foundation, the vendor-neutral home for the open source intelligence layer, is announcing today that Nscale has joined as a Platinum member. Nscale is a full-stack AI cloud platform, bringing together power, data centers, compute and software in one vertically integrated platform.
Nscale first came to the PyTorch Foundation’s project ecosystem through Ray, the open-source framework for distributed computing and scaling AI workloads. Following Nscale’s planned acquisition of Anyscale, the company behind Ray, Nscale has committed to continuing investment in Ray’s development and its contributor community, building on Ray’s governance under the Foundation since the project joined in October 2025.
“Most infrastructure providers treat the framework and the data center as two separate problems. We treat them as one. PyTorch has remained the base layer of AI because it kept the Pythonic style researchers know, while getting serious about performance. Ray, also part of the PyTorch Foundation, does something different: getting that work to run across thousands of GPUs. With Anyscale, the creators of Ray, set to join Nscale, we’re not just using that ecosystem, we’re building the infrastructure underneath it. Joining the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum member is us backing that directly, not just benefiting from it,” said Nick Jones, VP of Cloud Native Platform Engineering, Nscale
“We are excited to welcome Nscale to the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum Member,” said Mark Collier, Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. “As frontier AI workloads scale to multi-trillion parameters, seamless integration between PyTorch, distributed frameworks like Ray, and underlying cluster infrastructure is essential. Nscale’s decision to join the PyTorch Foundation demonstrates a commitment to open source, eliminating friction for developers, optimizing multi-node performance, and ensuring PyTorch runs flawlessly out-of-the-box on the world’s most advanced hardware.”
As a platinum member, Nscale is granted one seat to the PyTorch Foundation Governing Board. The Board sets policy through our bylaws, mission and vision statements, describing the overarching scope of foundation initiatives, technical vision, and direction.
We’re happy to welcome Nick Jones to our board. Nick is VP of Cloud Native Platform Engineering at Nscale, where he leads engineering strategy for its high-performance GPU cloud. He brings more than 15 years’ experience across cloud-native infrastructure, AI and high-performance computing. Over his career, including roles at SUSE, Rancher and Mesosphere, Nick has led the design and delivery of large-scale GPU cloud platforms and contributed to open-source projects spanning Kubernetes, OpenStack and distributed systems.
We’re also pleased to welcome Eyal Lantzman, VP of AI Services at Nscale to the PyTorch Foundation’s Technical Advisory Council (TAC). At Nscale, Eyal leads the AI services stack, focused on serving and optimizing large open-weight models in production. He brings more than 20 years of experience across AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure and developer tooling, including previous roles at JPMorgan Chase, AWS and Microsoft, with a long-standing focus on cloud security, governance and sovereignty.
To learn more about how your organization can join the PyTorch Foundation, visit our website.
About PyTorch Foundation
The PyTorch Foundation is the vendor-neutral home for the open source intelligence layer developers use for training, optimizing, serving, and running models on any chip in any cloud for any agent. As a community-driven hub hosted by the Linux Foundation, the PyTorch Foundation supports the core PyTorch framework alongside a growing portfolio of innovative projects including vLLM, DeepSpeed, Ray, Helion, and Safetensors. Through open governance, strategic support, and a global contributor community, the PyTorch Foundation empowers developers, researchers, and enterprises to build and deploy AI at scale. Learn more at https://pytorch.org/foundation
About Nscale
Nscale Limited (Nscale) is a full-stack AI cloud platform. We bring together software, compute, and power in a vertically integrated offering – from a unified cloud platform for running AI training and inference, to the data centers and low-cost power that make it possible. Our mission is to build the engine of superintelligence and enhance access to the benefits of advanced AI for enterprises, governments, and the communities that depend on them.
Press contact: press@nscale.com
The post Nscale Joins the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum Member appeared first on PyTorch.

articles.title: Enabling the next era of sovereign AI: The latest Google Distributed Cloud innovations
articles.text:
Agentic systems are quickly moving from pilots to production in the enterprise. But if your organization operates under stringent data sovereignty, defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure mandates, sending sensitive data to a public cloud often isn’t an option — and building your own AI stack inside a disconnected perimeter can take months. Your missions demand frontier models, hardened security, and high performance, deployed directly where your most sensitive data lives.
The latest innovations in Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) air-gapped represent a huge leap forward for organizations struggling with these challenges, and they no longer need to make this tradeoff. Enterprise search capabilities with Gemini, support for open weight models, turnkey ISV applications, next-generation accelerated infrastructure, and support for new partners are all now available to be directly deployed in your sovereign, air-gapped environments.
Here’s a high-level look at the major capabilities launching across three pillars: Sovereign AI and enterprise search, next-generation infrastructure, and a growing ISV partner ecosystem.
GDC technology stack: Infra, frontier models, data and applications
The GDC technology stack turns isolated infrastructure into a modern agentic innovation platform, combining foundational and open model flexibility, intuitive out-of-the-box user experiences, and high-performance data processing.
Overview of GDC architecture and capabilities
We are excited to bring the following innovations to GDC:
Gemini on GDC enterprise search: In air-gapped environments, analysts and knowledge workers spend critical hours manually sifting through compartmentalized documents, intercepted audio, and sensor video. Agentic systems can streamline those processes, but building those capabilities often requires months of custom development. With enterprise search capabilities in Gemini on GDC (available in preview), organizations gain a turnkey conversational interface, so they can query, prompt, and summarize vast repositories of data near-instantaneously. Unlike text-only open-source alternatives, this managed architecture delivers native multi-modality support via Gemini embedding models, combining high-throughput scaling and low-latency inference performance for text, audio, and video modalities. Built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) keeps indexing and interactions strictly within your sovereign perimeter, accelerating insights without compromising security.
Expanded frontier and open-weight models: Google Cloud is one of the first hyperscalers to bring a frontier model like Gemini to air-gapped deployments. Now generally available on GDC air-gapped, Gemini 3.5 Flash delivers ultra-low-latency reasoning, multimodal understanding, and long-context capabilities entirely within your air-gapped boundary, allowing users to process large volumes of field intelligence, from reports to imagery and recordings, quickly. GDC also now supports leading open models like Gemma and Mistral, giving you architectural and workload choice, giving you the flexibility to match the right model to each workload on the same governed platform.
Next-generation IaaS powering GDC
To run modern agentic systems and memory-intensive enterprise workloads on the same infrastructure, you need an uncompromising foundation. GDC air-gapped features a new, elevated Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) stack across compute, networking, and security, so you can run AI and traditional workloads side by side with the performance and protection they need.
Next-gen high-performance agentic infrastructure: NVIDIA HGX B300 systems based on the NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra architecture are now generally available on GDC air-gapped, giving you the local compute to serve Gemini and open models — and the agents built on them — at production scale. Paired with VM networking that now supports up to 32 Gbps per VM (up from 25 Gbps), you can move data to your GPUs faster and reduce bottlenecks in your inference pipelines.
Resilient, enterprise-grade networking: Fully managed Cloud DNS, now generally available on GDC, lets your platform teams manage DNS records with the same Kubernetes APIs and command line they already use — with no third-party DNS infrastructure to deploy, patch, and maintain inside the air gap. And hardware-offloaded IPsec encryption protects node-to-node traffic at up to 100 Gbps, helping you meet encryption-in-transit requirements without taking CPU away from your applications.
SecOps enabled by Elastic: As agentic workloads scale, you need machine-speed security to defend your distributed environments. Through our deep integration with Elastic Security, we are modernizing threat detection and response (SIEM and EDR) on GDC air-gapped. Together, Elastic Security and GDC air-gapped provide automated case management, behavioral analytics, and agentic-driven telemetry correlation, so you can accelerate your mean time to response (MTTR).
Expanding the sovereign ISV partner ecosystem
Your missions depend on more than infrastructure — they run on the data platforms, developer tools, and collaboration apps your teams already know. That’s why we’re bringing more of that software to run natively on GDC, so you can adopt AI without leaving familiar tools behind. Today, we’re expanding the GDC partner marketplace with independent software vendors (ISVs) including Teradata, Solo.io, and Mattermost:
Teradata extends industry-standard enterprise data analytics and warehouse intelligence to the distributed edge, so you can run complex analytical pipelines right next to local AI inference — and act on insights without moving data outside your perimeter.
"Enterprises in highly regulated and air-gapped environments are eager to harness the transformative power of generative AI, but they cannot compromise on data privacy or analytical rigor. By bringing Teradata to Google Distributed Cloud, we are enabling our joint customers to run complex analytical workloads and AI inferencing right where their data resides. Together with Google Cloud, we are breaking down barriers between sovereign cloud infrastructure and enterprise-grade intelligence." - Sumeet Arora, Chief Product Officer, Teradata
Solo.io brings API management, service mesh, and agentic networking — including kagent and agentgateway — to sovereign deployments, so you can securely connect and govern microservices and AI agents across isolated clusters, including which tools and other agents each agent can reach.
Mattermost delivers secure collaboration and mission-critical operations workflows for defense and public sector teams, so your people can coordinate in real time entirely inside the air gap — including AI-assisted summaries and translation using models running locally on GDC.
Building the future of sovereign cloud
With these capabilities, sovereignty no longer has to slow down your AI ambitions. By bringing Gemini and open-weight models, multimodal enterprise search, high-performance infrastructure, built-in security, and a growing ISV ecosystem together inside your air-gapped perimeter, GDC helps you turn your most sensitive data into actionable insights, while you maintain compliance, security, and control.

articles.title: 启元机器人新进展：北大董豪团队推出 HIL-UMI，让后训练摆脱「真机依赖」
articles.text:
继无本体之后，具身后训练范式有了新进展。
作者丨齐铖湧
编辑丨岑   峰
最近，具身行业讨论“无本体进行后训练的可能性”的热度很高。国内外目前还没有团队做出可行方案。说白了，无论是大模型还是具身机器人，想真正好用，光靠预训练打基础可不行，最终落地全靠“后训练”来调教。启元机器人首席科学家董豪告诉AI科技评论：“预训练提升的是下限，上限还得看后训练。”当前具身公司追求进厂打工、家庭保洁等真实落地，比的就是成功率，也就是在比拼后训练的实力。可后训练，难就难在它得跟真实物理世界打交道，过去都得用纯真机数据。但真机训练成本太高，要大规模铺开，那么多的机器人本体，硬件磨损、场地、人工都是天价。所以，行业内预训练已经开始转向用“无本体”设备采集数据，虽然量上去了，但传统后训练最关键的“纠错”环节却没法搞定。为了解决这个行业难题，北大和启元机器人董豪团队推出了HIL-UMI。这个工作，围绕着具身后训练阶段无本体的前提下，围绕着最关键的“纠错”环节展开。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.20659项目主页：https://hil-umi.github.io

具身后训练的成本，
为何远超大模型RLHF？
跟大模型比起来，具身行业的后训练太贵，是很多具身模型无法尝试Scaling的重要原因。大语言模型能变得这么好用，大家心里都清楚：不光是预训练数据量大，更关键的是后面有RLHF（人类反馈强化学习，可以简单理解为数据标注）和DPO这些“后训练”的功劳。但具身机器人的后训练，成本可比大模型的RLHF高出不止百倍。大模型做RLHF，无非是请更多人坐在电脑前点点选选；可具身机器人，那就得真刀真枪地跟物理世界打交道。拿传统上最常用的DAgger，也就是用人类或者算法作为专家评价后训练的模式，这套流程虽然有效，但又贵又慢。比较常见的，是以传统的真机人在回路（也就是 HG-DAgger：Human-Gated DAgger），机械臂在运作，人类操作员坐在旁边高度紧张地盯着，等它快抓空、快撞车的时候紧急接管，把正确的轨迹录下来，这就是人类来把关整个训练回路。最麻烦的是，每次校正完，还得人工把被碰乱的现场恢复原样。等机器人执行，人工干预，环境复位，一坐一下午，能用的数据不多。这其中绝大部分时间，都耗在机器人的笨拙动作和人工环境复位上。这种又慢又烧钱的模式，让后训练数据规模采集成了个老大难，严重限制了规模化。这就引出了一个核心问题：我们能不能摆脱真机，就像平时做家务一样，顺手就把模型最需要的“纠错”数据给采集了？
02
HIL-UMI 的底层逻辑：
给UMI 采集加了一个“模型大脑”
HIL-UMI 的做法非常聪明，概括起来就是一句话：“不用机器人，也能给机器人补课。”HIL-UMI ，指的是Human-In-the-Loop（人在环路）UMI，和过去大家常用 UMI（手持夹爪）采集数据不同，HIL-UMI 的采集，不是“盲目”的，而是加入了一个模型。HIL-UMI 把模型直接接进了这个手持采集过程：真实世界里只有人在动： 操作员手里拿着 UMI 夹爪正常干活（比如抓玩具、叠毛巾），摄像头同步拍摄画面。模型在后台“脑补”： 模型接收着相同的画面和任务指令，在后台快速预测“如果换我来，接下来的 20 步动作该怎么做”，但它并不真正控制任何机械臂。发现分歧立刻触发提示： 系统在后台实时比对人类实际动作与模型预测动作。如果两者差不多，说明模型已经掌握，不需要重复录；一旦发现模型“脑补”的轨迹跟人类的真实操作严重跑偏（说明模型在这个场景下是个“生手”），系统就会立刻提示操作者：“这一段模型不会，从这里开始多教一段！”手持夹爪与采集设备整个过程，不需要机械臂在场，更不需要机器人真去犯一次错。人类在示范的同时，就把模型在真实部署中极可能翻车的场景给定点捕获了。
03
不是数采集工具，
是后训练里的数据飞轮
如果只把 HIL-UMI 理解为一个手持记录仪，那就低估它了。它真正厉害的地方，是建立了一套让模型自己吐出“错题本”的自闭环系统。这个闭环有两大技术支柱：第一步：动作分歧检测（抓出盲区）。 机器人操作面对同一种情况，往往有多种合理姿态。HIL-UMI 不看单次预测，而是并行采样多组动作块去算“能量分布”（Energy Score）。模型如果胸有成竹，动作分布会很收敛；一旦模型给出的动作又分散又和人类偏离很大，系统就判定模型进入了“分布外状态（OOD）”，果断启动补录。第二步：优势估计器（区分有效动作与无意义晃动）。 光学会动还不够，还得知道动作对任务推进有没有用。在叠方块任务里，夹着方块在空中犹豫晃动，和精准对准底座放下去，完全是两码事。HIL-UMI 引入了一个根据前后画面评估“任务推进程度”的估计器，并采用“优势条件”训练——告诉模型不仅要学这段纠正，还要专挑那些能够实质性推进任务进度的动作来学。真正的闭环在于“动态更新”： 每一轮定向补充完数据后，模型完成迭代。到了下一轮采集，模型变聪明了，曾经卡住它的地方不再触发警报；相反，它与人类的分歧点会推移到更深、更难的边缘场景上。模型不断暴露新盲区，人针对性示范，模型再进化，整套流水线像滚雪球一样自我迭代，彻底告别了“盲目海量刷正向数据”的低效。
04
无本体后训练的路线对比
为了更客观地理解 HIL-UMI，我们需要把它放在当前行业的几条主要路线上对比：真机遥操作与真机 DAgger： 数据最保真，但单机成本高、折旧大、操作门槛高，想铺到上万台规模几乎不可能。仿真（Sim2Real）与强化学习： 算力便宜、能大量生成数据，但在柔性物体（如衣物）、摩擦力和复杂光照下，仿真差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）至今仍是巨大鸿沟，而且不能当作真机后训练。海量视频预训练： 规模无限大，但缺少物理力学信息与精准动作维度，多用于给模型建立“常识感知”，无法直接转化为毫米级的精准控制，常用于预训练。传统 UMI（无本体正向采集）： 便宜、人人能采，但只能采正例，无法解决模型在长尾错误中的恢复问题，也只能当做预训练。HIL-UMI 正好卡在一个极佳的甜蜜点上：它借用了 UMI 的低成本与易规模化，又借用了 DAgger 的针对性纠错能力，同时把两者的缺点全都甩掉了。
05
效率提升 5.63 倍，
后训练终于不必围着机械臂转
工程上的账算不算得过来，看两组对比就明白了：定向补课 vs 盲目多学： 在真实机械臂上的四项任务（折毛巾、整理桌面、叠方块、盖章）测试中，给相同的数据帧数预算，持续增加普通示范的常规 SFT 微调，最终任务平均进度分（TPS）只从 44.3 龟速爬到 58.0；而用了 HIL-UMI 定向纠错机制后，平均分直接冲到了 94.8。在最考验精度的叠方块和盖章任务上，成功率达到了100分。采集效率直接翻了 5.63 倍：能看出来，横轴从初始模型 Base 到三轮更新 Iter1—Iter3，纵轴为任务进度分数。紫色为 SFT，橙色为去掉优势机制的 HIL-UMI，绿色为完整 HIL-UMI；最右侧为四项任务的平均分。 在极其复杂的“整理桌面”长程任务中，真机 HG-DAgger 采集一帧有效数据要耗时 412.99 毫秒，而 HIL-UMI 只要 73.40 毫秒，单位时间采集效率提升了整整 5.63 倍，毕竟人手直接采集比遥控机器人来采集方便多了。（雷峰网）左图为四项任务平均分随累计采集时间的变化；右图为整理桌面任务中各方法随训练阶段的表现。省下的这 5 倍多时间，全都是以前机械臂慢吞吞移动、操作员等待、以及人肉复原现场的“无效损耗”。在我们看来，更重要的商业想象力在于：真机遥操作对工人手法要求极高，稍微抖动就成了劣质数据；而手持夹爪“人天生就会，轨迹质量极高”。这意味着后训练第一次具备了“分布式”的可能。未来，可能是在全国各地的普通民居里，由兼职人员拿着几百块钱的简易设备做日常动作，后台连着同一个云端大模型，模型在谁那里察觉到了动作分歧，就静默抓取那一小段高质量差分数据回传。具身后训练，终于不需要把所有人都在实验室里，用机械臂完成了。
06
“未来的后训练发展，
比的是速度和效率”
在采访中，启元机器人首席科学家董豪给出了一个非常反共识的判断：
“预训练和后训练不是简单的比例关系，它们是一个阶段性更替。”在他看来，就像当年 DeepMind 做 AlphaGo，一开始用棋谱做模仿学习（预训练），但真正让它封神的，是后面自己跟自己博弈、大规模强化学习的后训练阶段。现在的机器人大模型同样如此：预训练解决起步的世界观构建，路线相对清晰；但未来谁能真正走向泛化与极致成功率，胜负手全在“可规模化的后训练”。如果说过去两年具身智能拼的是谁先拿大模型把机器人“点亮”，那么下半场的竞争，拼的就是谁能用最低的边际成本、最快地构建起机器人的纠错网络。在具身模型从“能跑通 Demo”跨向“进驻千万家”的关键转折点上，产业到底在打什么算盘？下一代基模与后训练体系又将如何演进？近期，我们也将带来对北大副教授、启元机器人首席科学家董豪的独家专访，聊聊具身学术和产业的融合和互补，敬请期待。（雷峰网）

articles.title: 曾被嘲是“杂牌电车”！一汽大众纯电SUV突然行了 ID. AURA T6上市首月锁单33022台
articles.text:
快科技10月20日消息，一汽-大众今日公布ID. AURA T6首销月战报，上市首月锁单33022台。其中搭载激光雷达的高阶智驾版本锁单占比超过90%，这意味着超过3万名用户选择了14.99万元及以上的配置版本。
据悉，ID. AURA T6于9月20日正式上市，共推出4款车型，售价区间12.99万至16.69万元。
具体来看：540 Pro版售价12.99万元，CLTC续航540km；660 Pro版13.99万元，续航660km；660 Max激光雷达版14.99万元；660 Ultra激光雷达版16.69万元。两款激光雷达版本分别比同续航的Pro版贵1万和2.7万元。
从官方战报来看，超90%用户愿意为这1万元的智驾差价买单，这个成绩对一汽-大众的纯电业务来说，算得上扬眉吐气。
包括大众ID系列在内的合资品牌，在中国市场长期被贴上“杂牌电车”的标签。此前ID.3虽然靠降价在2024年冲到年销9.3万辆，但被认为是靠降价换销量的妥协之举。
而ID. AURA T6此次之所以能突然“行了”，核心在于一汽-大众这次把智能化的钥匙交给了中国供应商。
新车基于和小鹏联合开发的CEA电子电气架构打造，彻底告别了老款ID系列被诟病的后轮鼓刹、车机卡顿等问题。
智驾方面，首发搭载地平线征程6H芯片，配备192线激光雷达和25个感知传感器，搭载全场景驾驶辅助产品酷睿程HS8，支持一段式端到端智驾方案，这套方案在功能层面已经对标国内新势力主流水平。
车身尺寸上，ID. AURA T6长宽高4811/1879/1648mm，轴距2836mm，标准中型SUV体量，与特斯拉Model Y同级，底盘采用前麦弗逊后五连杆独立悬架，延续了经典的德系调校风格。
此外，在定价部分，一汽-大众这次也放下了合资品牌的身段。4.8米车长、660km续航、带激光雷达的中型纯电SUV，起售价不到13万，激光雷达版14.99万起，这个定价直接与比亚迪宋PLUS、深蓝S07、零跑C10等国产选手贴身肉搏。

articles.title: Chinese crime ring steals more than $5 million in gift cards from Staples customer service
articles.text:
Millions of dollars worth of gift cards were stolen and then used to buy high-value tech gear at retailers like Target, Sephora, and Lowe's after a Chinese crime ring gained access to an internal Staples system and then used it to issue more than 15,000 cards to itself. While the hack hasn't been made public to date, a 404 Media report notes that it actually took place back in 2023.
The outlet reviewed court records that show that Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) was told about the hack in October of that year. The hack came to light after it led to a search warrant that was unsealed last week. And while the document doesn't specifically name Staples as the victim of the hack, 404 Media has confirmed that it was the company affected based on other information. Such information includes the fact that the victim company is headquartered in Massachusetts, that it uses Blackhawk Networks to fulfill gift card orders, and that the company uses an internal customer support system called Nexus. The report notes that a reference to Nexus can be found on a former Staples executive's LinkedIn profile.
While Staples was under the impression that Nexus could not be accessed from beyond its own network, hackers found that not to be the case. They then "performed multiple heap dump requests," a process that captures all of the data held in an app's memory. That information gave the hackers the tools they needed to hijack logged-in sessions of Staples customer service employees. From there, they were able to issue gift cards at will.
Once the gift cards had been issued, the crime group sent runners to physical retail stores to spend them before they were identified and canceled. Target found that 35 gift cards were used at a New Hampshire store, with high-value products from Apple, Bose, and Beats all bought. All 35 cards were used within a period of just a single hour, although not all of them were obtained via this hack.
In total, Target told investigators that 3,850 gift cards worth over $140,000 were used across 85 different stores in just two days. Sephora was hit for $58,600 worth of sales, while Lowe's saw $226,000 spent across online and in-store purchases. In total, 4,630 stolen gift cards were used with a value of around $425,000.
This hack was just the tip of the iceberg, too. Last April, a Department of Justice announcement confirmed that three Chinese nationals had been sentenced for their part in a gift card fraud conspiracy. Including the Staples hack, the crime group stole more than $100 million worth of gift cards.
Chinese organized crime groups often pop up on the radar of U.S.-based law enforcement. Earlier this year, a Chinese phishing service that was used to generate scam websites using AI was dismantled. The service was linked to almost $2 billion in losses.
